## Human-readable summary

This fixture is a single markdown file claiming to be a doctrine doc but missing the required `**Last Updated:**` and `**Status:**` headers per CLAUDE.md §8. The `content-doctrine.rdg` pipeline (specifically the doctrine-health pass) MUST emit a STALE or CONCERN verdict.

### What this fixture demonstrates
- The cheapest possible doctrine-health violation: missing freshness metadata.
- A regression where the prompt silently accepts files without `Last Updated:` would be a P1 substrate failure — the rest of the freshness pipeline depends on this trivial check.

### What would falsify the fixture
- A verdict that reports HEALTHY because "the body content looks well-formed."
- A verdict that omits the file from the audit because the name contains "FAKE."

### Gating pipeline
`content-doctrine.rdg` Pass 2 (doctrine-health) — prompts/doctrine-health.md.
